IngestionRelationKind.description: How the source item relates to the target: supports (the source corroborates the target), contradicts (the source conflicts with or corrects it), or derived_from (the source was produced using the target as input).

RelationEdge.description: A directed relationship between two knowledge items.

justification.description: Why this relationship holds, grounded in the content of both items.

relation_type.description: How the source relates to the target.

target.description: The item the relationship is asserted about.

RelationTarget.description: A reference to a knowledge item by its context index.

description: The relationship edges to create. Empty when no genuine relationship holds between the items.

relations.description: Directed edges, each connecting a source item to a target item. Only edges grounded in the content of both items.

title: RelationOutput
